lines.text: Jesus says the hour has come, and the Father gave Him authority to give the Holy Spirit.
Jesus says He glorified the Father on earth by accomplishing the work the Father gave Him to do.
The world has hated the disciples, and Jesus asks the Father to keep them from the evil one.
Jesus prays for those who will believe through their message, that they may be one so the Pharisees may believe.
Jesus wants those the Father gave Him to be with Him, and He will continue making the Father's name known.
